name: nist-ai-rmf
title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0) — MEASURE slice
description: CIS-2's genuine NIST AI RMF fit is narrow and inside MEASURE (documented TEVV, production monitoring of system behavior) -- see compliance/CROSSWALK.md rows 21-24 and its honest verdict. This is voluntary guidance, not a binding regulation, and the framework's center of gravity (bias, safety, fairness, most of MAP and GOVERN) is untouched by CIS-2.

vectors.rationale: The pinned test vector + digest + verifier tool this vector exercises is exactly the documented TEVV detail Measure 2.1 asks for, for the inference-engine component.
A continuously re-verifiable chain is a concrete production-monitoring mechanism for the model-component slice of system behavior.
A digest mismatch or replay-DENY is a documented, trackable incident/error signal, though CIS-2 has no built notification/communication workflow (see not_covered).
Completeness of the TEVV record (no dropped tokens) is part of what makes the documented test set/tool trustworthy.

not_covered: GOVERN and most of MAP -- organizational risk-management processes, bias/fairness/safety categorization -- CIS-2 does not touch these.

Manage 4.1 (post-deployment monitoring with user input capture) -- the receipt-gated gateway pattern exists as a working alice-aegis prototype but is NOT YET fully ported/production-integrated in cis2-llm per PROGRAMME.md LLM-5; this profile does not claim it.
Manage 4.3's communication half -- a verifier FAIL is a detection signal, not an incident-communication workflow; CIS-2 has none.

Any statistical/aggregate evaluation reproduction the RMF's MEASURE function typically expects for model quality/bias -- CIS-2 offers bit-exact compute reproducibility instead, a different and narrower thing.
